entries.headline: Taiwan CDC adds Novavax to public COVID-19 programme from October 19
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: Public programme (公費): a second COVID-19 brand (protein-based Novavax) joins from October 19, and the CDC plans further flu and Novavax doses. Coverage repeated the date widely, alongside the 2.26 million flu-dose milestone.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗接種計畫
entries.why_zh: 公費計畫：第二個COVID-19疫苗品牌（蛋白質次單元Novavax）自10月19日起加入，疾管署並規劃增購流感及Novavax疫苗。媒體廣泛報導此日期，並同時提及流感疫苗接種突破226萬劑。

entries.headline: CDC exhausts open-ended contracts, orders about 474,000 extra doses for early November
entries.why: Public programme (公費) tender and supply story: outlets report roughly 300,000 flu and 174,000 COVID-19 doses, with delivery expected in early November. Some outlets attribute the 174,000 figure to flu, so reported splits are inconsistent.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署開口合約用罄，追加約47.4萬劑，預計11月初到貨
entries.why_zh: 公費計畫採購與供應議題：媒體報導約30萬劑流感疫苗及17.4萬劑COVID-19疫苗，預計11月初交貨。部分媒體將17.4萬劑歸為流感疫苗，各家報導的劑數拆分不一致。

entries.headline: Weekly flu toll hits 144 severe cases and 46 deaths; reports of shortage fears
entries.why: This is the backdrop driving demand on the public programme. One report says people fear shortages and are rushing to vaccinate, which raises supply-expectation risk for every flu supplier.
entries.headline_zh: 流感單週重症144例、死亡46例；傳出缺貨憂慮
entries.why_zh: 此為推升公費計畫需求的背景。一則報導指民眾擔心缺貨而搶打疫苗，使所有流感疫苗供應商面臨供貨預期風險。

entries.headline: Doctors link flu to stroke and cardiovascular risk, urge enhanced vaccines for elders
entries.why: Health-professional coverage of adjuvanted and high-dose options keeps the enhanced category visible even as its overall volume dips. Funding is not stated, so the relevance to public versus self-pay supply is unclear.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師指流感與中風及心血管風險相關，呼籲長者接種加強型疫苗
entries.why_zh: 醫療專業媒體對佐劑型與高劑量疫苗的報導，使加強型類別即使整體聲量下滑仍保有能見度。報導未說明經費來源，因此與公費或自費供應的關聯尚不明確。

entries.headline: Infant cluster at Changhua postpartum care home lifts RSV conversation
entries.why: A cluster of 16 infant infections within 20 days, in coverage tagged RSV, coincides with RSV volume roughly doubling week on week. A parent post on paying out of pocket for maternal RSV vaccination points to the self-pay (自費) arena.
entries.headline_zh: 彰化產後護理之家嬰兒群聚感染，帶動RSV討論
entries.why_zh: 20天內16名嬰兒感染的群聚事件（報導標註RSV），與RSV聲量較前一週約增加一倍同時發生。一則家長貼文提及自費接種孕婦RSV疫苗，顯示自費市場的動態。

entries.headline: Viral Threads anecdote implies skipping COVID-19 vaccination is healthier
entries.why: The post drew about 8,500 engagements, far above other social items, while a fact-check notes a retracted autopsy-study claim is recirculating. The risk touches both arenas but sits mainly with the public COVID-19 campaign.
entries.headline_zh: Threads熱門貼文暗示不打COVID-19疫苗比較健康
entries.why_zh: 該貼文互動數約8,500次，遠高於其他社群內容；另有事實查核指出，一項已撤稿的屍檢研究說法再度流傳。此風險涉及公費與自費兩端，但主要影響公費COVID-19疫苗接種。

watch.text: Novavax public COVID-19 vaccine becomes available. Watch for site availability, the media framing of the 'different process' angle and early uptake questions.
watch.text_zh: Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗開打。關注接種站點供應情形、媒體對「不同製程」角度的報導框架，以及初期接種相關疑問。

watch.text: Expected arrival of the roughly 474,000 top-up doses. Watch for gaps in stock before delivery and any shortage complaints.
watch.text_zh: 約47.4萬劑追加疫苗預計到貨。關注到貨前的庫存缺口及缺貨抱怨。

watch.text: Second stage of public flu vaccination opens, widening eligibility amid already strained supply.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打，在供應已吃緊的情況下擴大接種對象。

qa.q: Does the CDC top-up include enhanced (adjuvanted or high-dose) flu vaccines?
qa.a: Not confirmed. Several reports on the top-up reference enhanced flu vaccines, but no item gives a breakdown by type or brand. The CDC notice only mentions additional flu and Novavax doses.
qa.q_zh: 疾管署追加採購是否包含加強型（佐劑型或高劑量）流感疫苗？
qa.a_zh: 尚未證實。數則追加採購報導提及加強型流感疫苗，但均未提供依類型或品牌的劑數拆分。疾管署公告僅提及增購流感及Novavax疫苗。

qa.q: What do we know about the self-pay market this week?
qa.a: Very little. A Rotary club says self-pay vaccination is a heavy burden for vulnerable elders and calls for subsidies (COVID-19). A pregnant parent posts about paying out of pocket for an RSV vaccine. Some top-up stories mention both public and self-pay options, but none give stock or price data for enhanced flu, RSV or Tdap.
qa.q_zh: 本週自費市場有哪些資訊？
qa.a_zh: 資訊極少。某扶輪社表示自費接種對弱勢長者負擔沉重，呼籲提供補助（COVID-19）。一名孕婦發文提及自費接種RSV疫苗。部分追加採購報導同時提及公費與自費選項，但均未提供加強型流感、RSV或Tdap疫苗的庫存或價格資料。

qa.q: Is anti-vaccine content gaining traction around the campaign?
qa.a: One Threads anecdote implying unvaccinated people are healthier drew about 8,500 engagements. Other false claims (no effect on transmission, Australian injury claims) are low-engagement. A fact-check flags a retracted autopsy-study claim recirculating via video.
qa.q_zh: 反疫苗內容是否在接種期間擴大影響？
qa.a_zh: 一則暗示未接種者較健康的Threads貼文互動數約8,500次。其他不實說法（不影響傳播、澳洲傷害說法）互動數低。事實查核指出一項已撤稿的屍檢研究說法正透過影片再度流傳。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: The CDC's first in-season uptake update reported higher flu and COVID-19 numbers than last year, setting up the demand surge that triggered top-up orders.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署本季首次接種進度更新顯示，流感及COVID-19疫苗接種數高於去年，形成觸發追加採購的需求激增。

policy_notes.why: This notice formally adds Novavax as a second public COVID-19 option from October 19 and signals further flu and Novavax procurement, the week's key public-programme decision.
policy_notes.why_zh: 本公告正式將Novavax列為自10月19日起的第二種公費COVID-19疫苗選項，並釋出增購流感及Novavax疫苗的訊號，為本週公費計畫的關鍵決策。

misinfo.claim: An anecdote that an unvaccinated mother's unusually clean lung CT shows skipping COVID-19 vaccination is healthier
misinfo.note: High engagement; track spread and support clinician and CDC-led factual context rather than engaging the post directly.
misinfo.claim_zh: 一則個人經驗稱，未接種疫苗的母親肺部CT異常乾淨，顯示不打COVID-19疫苗比較健康
misinfo.note_zh: 互動數高；追蹤擴散情形，支持由臨床醫師及疾管署提供事實說明，而非直接回應該貼文。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccination makes no difference because vaccinated people still get infected and transmit
misinfo.note: Low engagement; keep evidence summaries ready for medical stakeholders if it spreads.
misinfo.claim_zh: 打COVID-19疫苗沒差，因為接種者仍會感染及傳播
misinfo.note_zh: 互動數低；備妥實證摘要，以便擴散時提供醫療利害關係人。

misinfo.claim: A US autopsy study found 74% of deaths were caused by COVID-19 vaccines
misinfo.note: Already debunked by a fact-check citing the retraction; monitor for the video recirculating.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美國一項屍檢研究發現74%的死亡由COVID-19疫苗造成
misinfo.note_zh: 已有事實查核引用撤稿說明予以澄清；持續監測該影片是否再度流傳。

misinfo.claim: Australians are sick, maimed or dead from COVID-19 vaccines, causing a skills shortage
misinfo.note: Imported, very low-engagement claim; no action beyond monitoring.
misinfo.claim_zh: 澳洲人因COVID-19疫苗生病、傷殘或死亡，導致技術人力短缺
misinfo.note_zh: 境外移入說法，互動數極低；僅需持續監測。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV conversation roughly doubled week on week, led by a report of 16 infant infections within 20 days at a Changhua Christian Hospital-linked postpartum care home (RSV tagged, pathogen not confirmed in the report) and a pregnant poster who paid out of pocket for a maternal RSV vaccine. Nothing this week names nirsevimab or infant antibodies directly.
products.implication: Postpartum care homes and newborn protection are becoming a visible issue, which may prompt questions from regulators, care-home operators and parents about infant RSV prevention options and who pays.
products.action: Prepare a factual evidence pack on infant RSV burden and prevention options for medical-information use; map postpartum care home and neonatal stakeholders; hold reactive lines ready in case the cluster pathogen is confirmed as RSV.
products.signal_zh: RSV討論較前一週約增加一倍，主因為一則報導指彰化基督教醫院相關產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒感染（標註RSV，但報導未確認病原），以及一名孕婦發文提及自費接種孕婦RSV疫苗。本週無任何內容直接提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體。
products.implication_zh: 產後護理之家與新生兒保護正成為顯著議題，可能引發主管機關、護理之家業者及家長對嬰兒RSV預防選項及費用負擔的疑問。
products.action_zh: 準備嬰兒RSV疾病負擔與預防選項的實證資料包，供醫藥資訊使用；盤點產後護理之家及新生兒相關利害關係人；備妥回應口徑，以因應群聚病原確認為RSV的情況。
who_zh: 產後護理機構相關公會

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.signal: Doctors quoted by Rti and Life link flu in older adults to stroke, cardiovascular and disability risk and urge consideration of adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines; one broadcast report describes these types as offering stronger protection. Several top-up stories mention enhanced vaccines, but none states whether the extra doses include them. High-dose volume fell (11 vs 18).
products.implication: Clinician-led framing keeps enhanced flu in the news, but product-type comparisons in public media could draw advertising-rule scrutiny, and unclear top-up composition may generate eligibility questions from facilities.
products.action: Keep engagement scientific: brief geriatric and cardiology societies with peer-reviewed evidence on request, confirm with Taiwan CDC how enhanced doses are allocated within the top-up, and ensure company spokespeople avoid product claims in media.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），核准用於65歲以上
products.signal_zh: 央廣及Life引述醫師指出，長者感染流感與中風、心血管及失能風險相關，呼籲考慮佐劑型或高劑量疫苗；一則廣電報導描述這類疫苗保護力較強。數則追加採購報導提及加強型疫苗，但均未說明追加劑數是否包含在內。高劑量聲量下滑（11對18）。
products.implication_zh: 以臨床醫師為主的論述讓加強型流感疫苗持續見報，但在大眾媒體比較產品類型可能引來廣告法規審視，且追加採購組成不明，可能引發醫療院所對接種資格的疑問。
products.action_zh: 維持科學性溝通：應要求向老年醫學及心臟學會簡報同儕審查實證，向疾管署確認追加採購中加強型疫苗的分配方式，並確保公司發言人在媒體上避免產品宣稱。
who_zh: 台灣老年學暨老年醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adolescents, adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Little this week: Tdap mentions are low (7 vs 5) and no top story names Tdap. The nearest item is a parent survey finding nearly 40% had not kept children on the routine schedule beyond flu and COVID-19, with calls for vaccine leave and child vaccine vouchers; it does not name Tdap.
products.implication: No live Tdap issue, but voucher and routine-schedule proposals could open a policy window for broader immunisation funding discussions.
products.action: Monitor voucher proposals and track whether advocacy groups include adolescent, adult or maternal boosters; keep a background brief on pertussis burden ready for policy stakeholders.
who: Parent advocacy groups behind the survey
products.sub_zh: 適用於青少年、成人及孕婦的百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週資訊甚少：Tdap提及數低（7對5），且無主要報導提及Tdap。最相關的是一項家長調查，發現近40%未讓孩子按時程接種流感及COVID-19以外的常規疫苗，並呼籲設立疫苗假及兒童疫苗券；該調查未提及Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 目前無Tdap相關熱點議題，但疫苗券及常規時程提案可能為更廣泛的預防接種經費討論開啟政策窗口。
products.action_zh: 監測疫苗券提案，追蹤倡議團體是否納入青少年、成人或孕婦追加劑；備妥百日咳疾病負擔背景資料，供政策利害關係人參考。
who_zh: 發起調查的家長倡議團體
立法院衛環委員會委員

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced on 13 October that Novavax, described as a vaccine of a different manufacturing process, joins the public COVID-19 programme from 19 October and that additional Novavax doses are planned; dozens of outlets relayed the start date.
products.implication: Launch week will bring scrutiny of site-level availability, booking and early-reaction posts in the public programme; brand-agnostic COVID-19 misinformation circulating online could attach to the new option.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus on distribution timing and contracted-site lists, prepare a factual backgrounder for media questions, and confirm adverse-event monitoring and medical-information channels are ready for 19 October.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單元疫苗，由Sanofi經銷
products.signal_zh: 疾管署10月13日宣布，被描述為不同製程疫苗的Novavax自10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗計畫，並規劃增購Novavax疫苗；數十家媒體轉述開打日期。
products.implication_zh: 開打週將出現對公費計畫中站點供應、預約及初期反應貼文的檢視；網路上流傳的不分品牌COVID-19不實資訊可能延燒至此新選項。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局協調配送時程與合約院所名單，準備因應媒體提問的事實背景資料，並確認不良事件監測及醫藥資訊管道於10月19日前就緒。
who_zh: 中華民國醫師公會全國聯合會

issues.title: Novavax public COVID-19 rollout begins
issues.note: Expect questions on which sites stock Novavax and posts about first-dose experiences; have availability and safety-monitoring lines ready.
issues.note_zh: 預期出現哪些站點提供Novavax的詢問及首劑接種經驗貼文；備妥供應情形及安全監測回應口徑。

issues.title: Stock gaps before top-up doses arrive and second stage opens
issues.note: Reports describe shortage fears and a rush to vaccinate, with 474,000 extra doses expected in early November and the second stage opening on 2 November.
issues.title_zh: 追加疫苗到貨及第二階段開打前的庫存缺口
issues.note_zh: 報導指民眾擔心缺貨而搶打疫苗，47.4萬劑追加疫苗預計11月初到貨，第二階段於11月2日開打。

issues.title: Infant infection cluster puts postpartum care homes in spotlight
issues.note: If the Changhua cluster is confirmed as RSV, expect calls on newborn protection and care-home infection control; prepare evidence and stakeholder map.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒群聚感染使產後護理之家成為焦點
issues.note_zh: 若彰化群聚確認為RSV，預期將出現新生兒保護及護理之家感染管制的呼聲；備妥實證資料與利害關係人盤點。

self_pay.title: Self-pay COVID-19 cost burden raised
self_pay.note: A Rotary club says self-paid vaccination is a heavy cost burden and calls for subsidies for vulnerable older adults; the report does not name a brand.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費COVID-19疫苗費用負擔受關注
self_pay.note_zh: 某扶輪社表示自費接種費用負擔沉重，呼籲補助弱勢長者；報導未提及品牌。

self_pay.title: Maternal RSV paid out of pocket
self_pay.note: One pregnant poster reports paying for an RSV vaccine and being told the price would be higher after birth; a single post, and nothing this week on clinic stock or prices for infant RSV antibodies.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高；僅此一則貼文，本週無診所嬰兒RSV抗體庫存或價格相關資訊。

self_pay.title: Little visibility on self-pay stock for enhanced flu or Tdap
self_pay.note: A few top-up reports mention both public and self-pay options and one notes shortage fears, but none gives self-pay stock, prices or demand for high-dose, adjuvanted flu or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感或Tdap自費庫存資訊有限
self_pay.note_zh: 少數追加採購報導同時提及公費與自費選項，其中一則提到缺貨憂慮，但均未提供高劑量、佐劑型流感疫苗或Tdap的自費庫存、價格或需求資訊。
